scheme_name: Award for Success in State Public Service Commission, Union Public Service Commission Examination (MPBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
Registration of the applicant must be renewed annually.
Applicant must possess a valid identity card issued by the Labour Department.
Applicant must be a son or daughter of a registered Building/Construction Worker.
Applicant must be selected at the Preliminary or Main level of either the State Public Service Commission Examination or the Union Public Service Commission Examination.
benefits_summary: Incentives ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 for selected candidates in SPSC or UPSC examinations.
documents_required: Valid identity card issued by the Labour Department
